text:
Type: storage cabinet with doors and drawers
Use: storing clothes, toys and supplies; children's room, bedroom, home office
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: laminated board, matte black door fronts, white drawer fronts with cut-out finger grips
Colors: white, matte black
Shape: narrow upright box with two black doors on top and three white drawers below, rectangular cut-out handles, flat top, sits flush on the floor, crisp graphic contrast, medium visual weight
Feel: graphic, tidy, playful, practical
Goes with: light wood, white walls, black and white accents, colorful textiles; Scandinavian children's rooms and bedrooms

product.name: STUVA
product.description: Low storage makes it easier for children to reach and organise their things.
